correctness.rationale: Complete inspected RESULT.md defines the exact icosahedral graph with 30 edges, the matching complex (5887 nonempty faces), A5 x C2 automorphisms, sign conventions and rational characters. Inspecting the entire finite exact verifier shows deterministic triangle-propagation enumeration of 120 automorphisms, full matching face generation, mod-2 Gaussian elimination of boundary matrices, all signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces, rational character inner products and equivariance incidence identities. Rational rank >= modular rank; chain-complex upper bounds saturate all degrees except H3=2535-1114-1357=64. Half-sums of (64,0,-2,-1) and (16,0,-2,1) yield (40,0,-2,0) and (24,0,0,-1), with W6 inner product divided by two, confirming (2,4,2),(2,2,1). The conclusion for rational quotient cohomology follows from finite-group averaging after subdivision. The script was inspected, not freshly executed, and the saved success log alone was not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The icosahedral matching complex and equivariant character are mathematically motivated. But prior Nov 1 results already calculate precisely the same full representation, signed traces, antipodal split, and rational orbit quotient consequences. Submitted proof is an alternative finite certificate, with no independently motivated new invariant, sharper bound, structural lemma or mathematical distinction beyond the previously published full character. Correct execution and reproducibility alone do not establish a new worthwhile contribution.

final_claim: For the ordinary matching complex of the 12-vertex icosahedral graph, rational reduced homology is concentrated in degree 3 and, under G=A5 x C2, has antipodal-even 2V4+4V5+2W6 and antipodal-odd 2V4+2V5+W6 (dimensions 40,24); both A5 and G orbit spaces are rationally acyclic in positive degrees.
